events.event_name: LIZN'BOW: El Mundo es Niña — Times Square Installation
events.address: Duffy Square / Broadway between 46th and 47th Streets, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A free public-art takeover with monumental inflatable sculptures in Times Square. The broader El Mundo es Niña project also includes the nightly Midnight Moment and a September 23 live performance.
events.what_is_free: Public viewing of the outdoor inflatable sculpture installation; no ticket or RSVP requirement is published by Times Square Arts.
events.caveats: Outdoor public installation. Times Square Arts lists the sculptures September 20–27. A separate live performance is scheduled September 23; published Times Square Arts pages conflict between 10 PM and 10:30 PM for that performance, so this record does not publish an exact performance time as settled fact.
events.practical_notes: The sculpture installation is listed as 24/7 September 20–27. The Midnight Moment video runs nightly at 11:57 PM elsewhere across Times Square screens.

events.address: Chief Clubhouse, 13 East 19th Street, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive sustainable-home experience with 70+ brands, product sampling, a Gifting Garden and talks spanning climate, culture, food, fashion, beauty and business.
events.what_is_free: Registration and admission are free; programming includes interactive brand experiences, product sampling and the PlanetHAUS Gifting Garden.
events.caveats: Registration is free, but a current Climate Week/UNGA event map explicitly describes organizer approval as required. Do not present submission of the registration form as confirmed admission.
events.practical_notes: Open September 21 and 22. Current sources differ slightly on opening time: the official Climate Week listing shows 9 AM on Sept. 21 while organizer/secondary listings describe 8:30 AM–4 PM both days. This tracker uses the official-calendar time where available and flags the discrepancy rather than inventing certainty.

events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up with product discovery, samples and meditation experiences in Vanderbilt Hall.
events.what_is_free: Product discovery and samples. Self-guided meditation spots are offered by reservation or first-come; special guided sessions require advance sign-up and have limited capacity.
events.caveats: Current discoverable source says self-guided spots are available either by reservation or first-come, while the special 10-minute guided meditation sessions require sign-up and are capacity-limited. A direct official Tatcha event page was not independently recovered in this pass, so the source distinction is preserved.
events.practical_notes: Monday Sept. 21: 9 AM–7 PM. Tuesday Sept. 22: 8 AM–7 PM. Vanderbilt Hall inside Grand Central Terminal.
